_about: Whether generative AI made an asset. false only where an asset provably predates generative image AI: first published before 2022-04-01 (git history for Bioicons/Health Icons/OpenMoji, ignoring later redraws by outside contributors; sitemaps + Wayback captures for Servier; API created_at + Zenodo DOIs for SciDraw; Wayback captures of icons and icon-lib-svg.tgz for Reactome). false for all of NIAID BioArt (made by NIAID's professional medical illustrators; no outside contributions, per bioart.niaid.nih.gov/faqs). true where the contributor said so (OpenMoji PR #627, Ontario flag). Everything else is not known: no source states an AI policy. For BioCartoon uploads (source user) an entry here overrides what the uploader said; all uploads to date are AI-generated. `details` says how AI was used. Researched 2026-11-13.

details.OM013596: Drafted with an LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5 in Cline); the crest was then corrected by hand (OpenMoji PR #627).
